'''Naboo swamp moss''' was a type of [[Moss/Legends|moss]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The moss grew in sheets and hung from the branches of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on the borders of Naboo's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Naboo swamp moss was briefly mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
